Nicolai Bang Foss is a Danish medical professional serving as a clinical professor, chief physician (*overlæge*), and Doctor of Medicine (*dr. med.*) [^src1]. He is professionally affiliated with Amager and Hvidovre Hospital, located in the Capital Region of Denmark (*Region Hovedstaden*) [^src1]. 

Foss plays a direct role in national clinical quality development as a member of the [[akut-kirurgi-databasen-styregruppe]] [^src1]. He represents the Danish Society of Anaesthesiology and Intensive Care Medicine (*Dansk Selskab for Anæstesiologi og Intensiv Medicin*) on this committee [^src1]. His inclusion in the steering group ensures that specialized anesthesiological and intensive care medical expertise is integrated into the oversight, governance, and quality improvement initiatives of the Acute Surgery Database (AKDB) [^src1]. This interdisciplinary and cross-regional committee structure is a core component of the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP), guiding the database's clinical indicators and operational practices.
